title: Combined document processor improvements
body:
This PR combines all the document processor improvements requested in a single PR:

1. Tree Structure Handling:
   - Fixes TypeError with NoneType in document processor
   - Improves tree structure handling logic
   - Adds safety checks for None values

2. Enhanced Logging:
   - Improves progress visibility during processing
   - Adds better file processing feedback
   - Enhances debug output formatting

3. Code Quality:
   - Removed obsolete f-string prefix
   - All linting checks now pass (black, isort, flake8)
   - Improved code formatting

All pre-commit hooks are passing:
- black: ✅
- isort: ✅
- flake8: ✅
- prettier: ✅
- trailing whitespace: ✅
- end of files: ✅
- mixed line ending: ✅

This PR supersedes and closes:
- #107 (Tree structure fix)
- #108 (Logging improvements)
- #109 (F-string fix)
author: doobidoo
